crossRefs.note: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
“ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
“ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

people.name: Adonijah
people.line: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne

people.name: Bathsheba
people.line: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Bathsheba therefore went to king Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
translations.bsb: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah. The king stood up to greet her, bowed to her, and sat down on his throne. Then the king had a throne brought for his mother, who sat down at his right hand.
translations.kjv: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
translations.asv: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
